environment.description: EC2 instance (t3.medium) running this Node.js monolith directly exposed via public ALB on port 443. No rate limiting configured. ALB target group health check on /health. Security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 inbound on 443. Node.js 18 runtime, single-threaded event loop. No request timeout configured at application level. ALB idle timeout set to default 60 seconds.

config.timeout: ALB idle timeout 60s, no app-level timeout
